title: From Drift to Reversal: Temporal Changes in Delayed Price Reactions to Earnings Announcements
one_line: Over the past two decades, the link between this quarter's earnings news and next quarter's announcement reaction turned negative: PEAD continuation has become reversal, and a PEAD strategy earns negative returns at the next announcement after 2002 (only after positive news; stronger with aggressive trading and limits to arbitrage).

findings.statement: PEAD continuation replaced by reversal; negative PEAD-strategy returns at the next announcement after 2002.
findings.evidence: Seminar abstract; authors not listed on the page (title matches).

findings.statement: Reversal only after positive news; concentrated in high limits-to-arbitrage stocks.

why.pattern: Overreaction by aggressive traders at announcements.

tradable_edge: Stock-level; together with Martineau (2021) it argues to retire the PEAD stock specs.
